questions.explanation: A green producer captures light energy during photosynthesis and stores some of it as chemical energy in organic compounds.
questions.trap: The producer makes its own carbohydrates as part of photosynthesis.
questions.mnemonic: Sunlight enters a grazing chain through producers.

askPresets.answer: Sunlight enters a grazing chain through producers.
The producer makes its own carbohydrates as part of photosynthesis.
